notes: Pay that goes straight into an investment account (the slice of a paycheck the payroll office sends to UBS) now counts as income: it shows up in Settings > Income sources, so it can be assigned to a person, appears in the Income report with the account it landed in (the Statement stays bank-money only), and in the Money flow diagram it flows source > person > Income > To investments, feeding the investment row's 'Put in'. Tooltips and the summary say how much was paid straight in.
